lines.meet: My name's Nizar, and I'm a chronomancer. If you'd permit me, I'll call out the order of things in a fight, because it helps if somebody keeps the sequence.
lines.meet_neighbour: We both live aboard the Crossing, I believe. I'm Nizar, in the cabin with the notebooks, and I should like to know you better.
lines.ask_home: If you'd permit me, may I ask where you were born?
lines.ask_work: And your profession, before? I should like to know, if you don't mind.
lines.answer_home: Homs, in Syria. Then Beirut, then Hamburg, and now here, which is simply the fourth time I've started again.
lines.answer_work: I taught mathematics for twenty-one years, in three countries and three languages. The proofs stayed the same.
lines.chat_food: Strong coffee with cardamom, very early, before the first lesson. My wife made it, and then I learned to make it for my daughter.
lines.chat_sleep: I sleep a little, and I wind my father's watch every morning. It runs backwards now, and I wind it anyway.
lines.chat_missing: The BBC World Service on the radio at night. I learned my English from it, and I can no longer hear it.
lines.chat_here: The first time you lose everything it destroys you. The second time it's merely very hard. The third time you find you have a method.
lines.tease_quiet: You're as patient as my best students, {name}, the ones who waited for the proof to finish. I always liked them.
lines.tease_talker: You'd have been a lively student, {name}. I'd have asked you to wait until the end of the lesson, and you wouldn't have.
lines.tease_careful: You show your working, {name}. I've been waiting twenty-one years to say that to somebody.
lines.tease_bold: You'd skip three steps of the proof and still get the right answer, {name}. It's infuriating, and I admire it.
lines.tease_any: If you'd permit me, {name}, your arithmetic is atrocious. I've decided to help, whether you'd like it or not.
lines.tease_back: That was elegant, {name}. I concede the point.
lines.take_it_kindly: You're quite right, {name}, and I'm grateful you said so.
lines.bristle: I should prefer that you didn't make a jest of it, {name}, please.
lines.apologise: I spoke carelessly, and I apologise. That isn't how I'd wish to speak to anyone.
lines.double_down: I chose my words carefully, and I should like to keep them.
lines.needle_quiet: If you've noticed something, please say so. A student who sits silently with a question learns nothing.
lines.needle_talker: If you'd permit me, perhaps somebody else might speak. We're losing the sequence.
lines.needle_careful: You're waiting for certainty that won't come. At some point one must commit to an answer.
lines.needle_bold: You're careless, and carelessness in a proof is forgivable. Here, it isn't.
lines.needle_any: You give up on people too easily. I've never been able to watch that calmly.
lines.bite_back: I've rebuilt my life three times, and this is the fourth. I'd ask you not to lecture me about difficulty.
lines.hurt: Ah, I understand you. I'll go and wind my watch, and think about it.
lines.laugh_off: Teenagers in three countries were ruder than that, in three languages. Let's continue, shall we?
lines.confide: {name}, my daughter and I spoke every single day, and the last call was at fourteen minutes past nine, the night before. I kept a notebook of every hub and every list, with dates.
lines.listen: Thank you for trusting me, {name}. I'll keep it carefully, as one keeps a proof.
lines.look_out: Stay to my right in there, {name}, if you'd permit me. I'll call the sequence for you.
lines.deflect: It's quite all right, {name}, I assure you. The others need you first.
lines.check_in: If you'd permit me, {name}, where exactly is the injury? Tell me slowly.
lines.blame: Somebody abandoned the sequence in there, and the result was predictable. I'm sorry to say it.
lines.thank: I'd lost the thread entirely, and you gave it back to me. Thank you, most sincerely.
lines.brush_off: It was nothing, please. Rest a moment, and breathe.
lines.worry: Please sit, {name}, and allow me to check. That was a great deal closer than I'd like.
lines.handed_down: It seems I've been given your gear. I'll take great care of it, and you've only to ask.
lines.hand_fine: Please, it's yours, and you use it better. I need very little.
lines.hand_sulk: I should have appreciated being consulted. I wasn't consulted.
lines.turn_friendly: I find I look forward to your company, {name}. That's become rare for me, and I'm grateful.
lines.turn_friends: I'd tell you about my daughter, {name}, all of it, the way I'd tell family. That's the most I can say.
lines.turn_grating: We don't seem to get on, I'm afraid. I'll remain courteous, as I'd hope you will.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll call your sequence in a fight, because it's my duty. Beyond that, I'll ask nothing of you.
lines.make_up: I should like to apologise, {name}, and to begin again. If you'd permit me.
lines.defend: If you'd permit me, that's simply untrue. Leave {name} alone, please.
lines.friend_left: The sequence feels incomplete now that {name} is away.
lines.friend_back: Ah, {name}, welcome back. I'm very glad to see you.
lines.common_teacher: Twenty-one years teaching mathematics in three countries. A teacher learns to explain the same proof the ninth time without letting it show, and I suspect you've done that too.
lines.common_numbers: I've loved numbers since I was a boy, because they hold still when everything else moves. People who love them understand that, I think.
lines.common_arabic: You're speaking Arabic! If you'd permit me, it's a great comfort to hear it.
lines.common_parent: My daughter Hala went to Amman to study medicine. I raised her the rest of the way on my own, after her mother died.
